en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden building with many windows, surrounded by tall trees and a gravel path. People in early‑1900s clothing are sitting on benches, standing in front of the building, and a child with a bicycle is in the foreground. Handwritten cursive text in red and black ink is overlaid on the lower half of the image. Printed text appears along the bottom edge.
